# Copilot review instructions

- Prioritize correctness, security, accessibility, deterministic behavior, and useful tests.
- Flag exposed secrets, unsafe browser behavior, unnecessary permissions, and supply-chain risks.
- Check keyboard-operable forms, readable workload summaries, responsive layout, and text alternatives to color-only status.
- Check integer-minute arithmetic, capacity boundaries, and backlog exclusion from daily totals. Completing a task must reduce remaining work without changing scheduled workload.
- Check persistence validation, visible storage failures, and explicit confirmation before replacing user data with the example week.
- Check that unit and browser tests assert meaningful user behavior rather than implementation details.
- Expect the repository-defined validation command and CI to pass for application changes. This intentionally empty setup baseline has no application tests or build yet.
- Distinguish local evidence from pending remote CI/review. Focus on actionable defects, not extra features or polish beyond the bounded demo scope.
- Do not request deployment, hosting, cloud infrastructure, or unrelated scope expansion.
